$comment: Release-gate thresholds. code_metrics are produced by deterministic scorers and also gate tier 1 (offline, credential-free); judge_metrics are routed through the approved judge-model and gate only in the full run. report_only_judge_metrics execute but must be calibrated against held-out human labels before moving into judge_metrics with a threshold. Every threshold must be categorized in exactly one gated list. max_regression compares against evals/baseline.json when present.
